baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from the doubled repentance root through sincere quality, covering of evils, and completion of light.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressed return initiates a repair process: sincerity stitches a rupture, covering removes the operative trace of wrong, and completion carries the repaired life to wholeness.

activation_trace.role: Soliciting repentance from another makes the imperative address the process's initiating call.
Stitching a tear supplies the concrete repair operation performed by sincere repentance.
Covering an offense until it is as if unworked supplies removal of the damage's effective trace.
Reaching a thing's full limit supplies the repair's requested endpoint.
Covering fault while shielding its bearer from the consequence makes forgiveness protective, not cosmetic.

changed_reading.before: Repentance is followed by several independent rewards.
changed_reading.after: Repentance begins one repair trajectory whose operations are stitching, consequence-removal, protection, and completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Their light runs before them and at their right, yet they ask for that light to be completed.
baseline_models.mechanism: Light is an advancing guide rather than a static possession: it occupies the near-ahead interval, moves purposefully, and remains dynamically incomplete enough to require completion.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the visible medium that guides rather than merely decorates.
Purposeful movement toward a goal turns the light into an advancing escort.
The interval between parties gives the light a relational field in which to move.
What is before the hands locates the light immediately ahead and near to realization.
Completion marks the moving guide as sufficient only when its course reaches fullness.

changed_reading.before: The light is a finished badge already possessed on the day of judgment.
changed_reading.after: The light is a mobile guidance process whose advance is real while its full reach is still being prayed for.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah joins covering evils and forgiveness to a day without disgrace and to conspicuous light.
baseline_models.mechanism: Restoration selectively changes visibility: culpable traces are covered and their bearer protected from humiliating exposure, while the restored person is not hidden but made luminous.

activation_trace.role: Effacing sin by covering supplies concealment of the culpable trace.
Public humiliation and expulsion identify the exposure from which the cohort is protected.
A protective covering supplies the shield around the person after fault is addressed.
Illumination makes restored persons visible, preventing covering from becoming erasure of the person.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness hides the person together with the person's past.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness hides the damaging trace while light reveals the restored person without disgrace.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Light appears at their right sides immediately before their spoken plea for completion and forgiveness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The right-side image can carry commitments and deeds into visibility: pledged allegiance and enacted work become a luminous, forward-running accompaniment rather than an external lamp.

activation_trace.role: The oath and pledged bond make the right side a possible register of commitment.
Attributing what was earned to the hands lets enacted deeds supply the light's material history.
Work and acquisition make the running light an active yield of lived practice.
Audible speech turns the final plea into a renewed commitment enacted in the scene.

changed_reading.before: The light beside them is wholly external equipment granted at the end.
changed_reading.after: The light may also manifest the commitments and deeds now accompanying their speakers, while remaining dependent on divine completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prohibition-to-dissolution sequence recasts sincere repentance as exact unbinding of a malformed commitment so that a sound commitment can be completed; it is neither casual release nor mere remorse.

activation_trace.role: Prohibition supplies the binding constraint from which the sequence begins.
A precisely bounded obligation makes release itself disciplined rather than arbitrary.
Dissolution of an oath supplies the operative unbinding of a pledged knot.
The oath branch identifies the commitment being released and responsibly reset.
Stitching the rupture supplies the rebinding side of the repentance mechanism.
Completion gives the repaired commitment a positive endpoint beyond release.

structural_cues: Across 66:1-2, a self-imposed prohibition is followed by a prescribed dissolution of oaths before 66:8 commands sincere repentance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, bounded obligation, oath-dissolution, stitching, and completion; I infer an analogy from legal unbinding to inward repair, while the live alternative is that 66:1-2 only supplies a contrastive legal episode.

changed_reading.before: Sincere repentance means feeling remorse intensely.
changed_reading.after: Sincere repentance is a controlled unbinding and repair of commitments so conduct can proceed under a truer bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The handling of a secret models correction by calibrated visibility: what is hidden can be disclosed, enough can be identified for repair, and some can be turned aside, matching coverage without humiliating erasure.

activation_trace.role: Concealment in the interior supplies the initially hidden material requiring ethical handling.
Emergence into view supplies disclosure rather than permanent suppression.
Recognition through a distinguishing trace supplies enough identification for accountability.
Turning a side away supplies restraint after necessary recognition.
Covering the offense supplies the non-exhibition phase after correction.
Humiliating exposure names the outcome that calibrated disclosure avoids.

structural_cues: 66:3 sequences secrecy, divine disclosure, partial identification, and turning aside from another part.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reveal-recognize-turn-aside sequence and 66:8 supplies covering without disgrace; I infer a pedagogy of proportionate disclosure, while total exposure or episode-specific discretion remain alternatives.

changed_reading.before: Covering wrongs means keeping them wholly unseen.
changed_reading.after: Coverage can follow sufficient disclosure for repair while refusing needless humiliation or totalizing exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repentance becomes a vector change: the heart's tilt is turned, and the network of backing and nearness is correspondingly realigned, giving the forward-running light a social as well as inward direction.

activation_trace.role: The heart's inclination supplies the initial directional bias that repentance must alter.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the reversal of that inward vector.
Strength through backing supplies the coalition that reinforces the new orientation.
Nearness, love, and support supply the relational field into which the heart is realigned.
Purposeful advance makes the resulting light express the corrected direction.

structural_cues: 66:4 places conditional repentance immediately against a tilted heart and a competing pattern of mutual backing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inclination, reversal, backing, and nearness; I infer that inward turning alters relational allegiance, while the alternative is a narrower warning about one alliance only.

changed_reading.before: Repentance is an isolated inward reset.
changed_reading.after: Repentance redirects both the heart and the support structure that carries its choices forward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated 'perhaps your/his Lord' frame activates replacement: repentance may release a failed configuration and let a better ordered set of qualities stand in its place, rather than merely clean the unchanged self.

activation_trace.role: Release from a bond supplies separation from a failed configuration.
One thing standing in another's place supplies genuine reconfiguration rather than surface cleaning.
Superior fitness supplies the criterion governing what replaces the released pattern.
Gradual repair and upbringing supply governance of the replacement process.
Completion integrates the replacement qualities into a whole.

structural_cues: 66:5 and 66:8 repeat the 'perhaps Lord' construction around replacement and covering-entry respectively.
The catalog in 66:5, including branchless ث ي ب at word 16, structurally presents a whole replacement profile rather than one amended trait.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, substitution, comparative good, repeated syntax, and a quality catalog; I infer an analogy to reconfigured character, while literal replacement of persons remains confined to 66:5.

changed_reading.before: The same self is cleaned but otherwise left structurally unchanged.
changed_reading.after: Repentance can permit a failed configuration to be displaced by a better integrated pattern of qualities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near sequence differentiates two luminous economies: persons and stones become fuel for consuming fire, whereas repentant persons bear purposeful light; protection and repentance redirect the person's relation to luminous energy from consumed material to guided bearer.

activation_trace.role: Driving off harm by a shield supplies the preventive transition away from fire.
Kindled fire supplies the destructive luminous pole contrasted with the focus light.
Fuel material identifies the role persons must cease to occupy.
Hard stone intensifies the image of inert material surrendered to combustion.
Guiding illumination supplies the constructive luminous pole borne by the repentant cohort.
Goal-directed motion distinguishes living guidance from inert fuel.

structural_cues: 66:6's fire and 66:8's light share the packet root mapping ن و ر and occur two ayat apart around the judgment warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared root mapping, fuel, protection, and mobile illumination; I infer a reversal in the person's relation to luminous force, while the live alternative is simply two opposed outcomes without conversion between them.

changed_reading.before: Fire and light are unrelated punishment and reward images.
changed_reading.after: They form a reversal: repentance moves the person from passive fuel of destructive luminosity toward an active bearer of guiding luminosity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ban on excuses and exact correspondence between action and recompense make the running light a legible forward projection of purposeful work; repentance changes the work before the day when retrospective speech cannot substitute for it.

activation_trace.role: The excuse branch marks retrospective speech as unavailable on the decisive day.
Action answered by its corresponding recompense supplies the light's accountability logic.
Intentional work supplies the conduct whose consequence becomes visible.
Work and earning let the light's running embody lived effort.
What the hands earned makes the forward field a record of personally enacted conduct.

structural_cues: 66:7 closes retrospective excuse and names recompense for work immediately before 66:8 opens a present imperative to repent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no-excuse judgment, action-correspondence, work, and hand-attributed deeds; I infer that light renders transformed work legible, while it may alternatively remain a divine reward only loosely related to deeds.

changed_reading.before: The final plea can compensate for an unchanged record of action.
changed_reading.after: The plea accompanies a light already running as visible consequence of changed work; it does not replace that work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hidden-exit branch gives sincerity an architectural test: repentance is nasuh when its apparent entrance has no concealed route back to the abandoned pattern and effort is spent making the repaired course hold.

activation_trace.role: Exerting capacity under difficulty supplies the effort needed to keep the repaired course intact.
Showing one entrance while hiding an exit supplies the precise architecture that sincere repentance negates.
Freedom from admixture or deceit makes the return structurally single rather than double-faced.
Hidden corruption inside an apparent entry names the inward defect the sincere model excludes.

structural_cues: 66:9 places strenuous opposition beside hypocrisy directly after the sincere-repentance command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies difficult exertion, an apparent door with a concealed exit, purity from admixture, and hidden internal corruption; I infer that nasuh closes the return route, while hypocrisy may remain a social category rather than a map of repentance.

changed_reading.before: Sincere repentance is an emotionally earnest entrance into a better state.
changed_reading.after: It is an entrance whose hidden exit back to the old pattern has been exposed and closed through sustained effort.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failed protection of being under righteous spouses prevents 'with him' from becoming borrowed salvation: accompaniment names a cohort, but betrayal, sufficiency, entry, and each cohort's own light keep responsibility non-transferable.

activation_trace.role: Spatially being beneath another supplies the relation that proves unable to shelter by itself.
Deficient fidelity breaks the assumption that close affiliation transfers integrity.
Sufficiency denied to the spouses marks the limit of another person's protective capacity.
Personal entry into the destination supplies the non-transferable terminal act.
Heart-settling affirmation defines membership by an enacted stance, not proximity alone.
Their own illumination makes accompaniment a cohort of bearers rather than one bearer lending light to all.

structural_cues: 66:8 says believers are with the prophet and immediately assigns light to them collectively; 66:10 then denies rescue through intimate proximity to righteous servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed relational shelter, betrayed fidelity, denied sufficiency, personal entry, and possessed light; I infer a corrective contrast with 'with him,' while shared prophetic accompaniment remains genuinely supportive rather than irrelevant.

changed_reading.before: Being with the prophet is itself the mechanism that supplies the cohort's light.
changed_reading.after: Accompaniment identifies a shared path, but repentance, fidelity, entry, and luminous responsibility cannot be inherited from the nearest righteous person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden becomes a constructed counter-dwelling: rescue separates the speaker from an oppressive person, work, and people, while nearness, building, and shelter assemble a new habitation under divine care.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts into a building supplies active formation of the alternative dwelling.
Nearness and presence locate the new dwelling by relation to God rather than the old regime.
Shelter and habitation make the garden a home rather than scenery.
Deliverance by separation supplies the exit from person and collective required for relocation.
Intentional work identifies the oppressive system as practice, not only place.
A tree-covered garden supplies the protected ecology in which the counter-home stands.
Entry supplies relocation into the constructed alternative.

structural_cues: 66:11's prayer repeats the focus prayer's Lord-address and places building, nearness, garden, and two rescues in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies building, shelter, nearness, separation, oppressive work, garden, and entry; I infer a counter-dwelling produced through extraction, while the garden can still be read simply as the named afterlife destination.

changed_reading.before: Admission to gardens is relocation into a ready-made reward landscape.
changed_reading.after: Admission is also the formation of a new home and social location after separation from an oppressive person, practice, and collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The guarded opening that receives breath and confirms words revises purity from sealed closure to governed permeability: a sound boundary blocks violation while remaining open to life-giving ingress and truthful expression.

activation_trace.role: Preservation inside an enclosing fort supplies the integrity of the boundary.
An opening between two sides supplies permeability within that protected boundary.
Sending breath into something supplies beneficial ingress through the opening.
Life-bearing spirit supplies what the guarded opening receives.
Making word and act true supplies outward integrity after inward reception.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the communicative flow that is admitted and affirmed.
Stitching a tear supplies repair of a boundary without abolishing every opening.
Opening and widening until flow becomes possible supplies the focus ayah's life-bearing permeability.

structural_cues: 66:12 sequences guarding, an opening, ingress of breath, and confirmation of words; 66:8 sequences repair, entry, flowing channels, and completed light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fortification, aperture, breath, life, truthful enactment, speech, stitching, and opened flow; I infer selective permeability as their common mechanism, while the bodily sequence can remain a unique sign rather than a general repentance model.

changed_reading.before: Purity and sincere repentance require sealing the self against all ingress.
changed_reading.after: Integrity is a repaired and guarded boundary that excludes violation while admitting life, truth, speech, and sustaining flow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The milk-return, nurture, blossom, and sustained-flow branches are materially distant from the ordinary constructions, which makes the reading surprising; they remain anchored in the exact hope-Lord-light-flow-completion chain and converge on resumed life. Render this only as a regenerative analogy, never as the lexical gloss of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ayah's hope construction, nurturing Lord, flowing gardens, blossoming light, and request for completion can form a dormant-to-living sequence.

activation_trace.role: Hope for milk to return after cessation supplies the image of dormant provision becoming active again.
Feeding and growth supply the nurturing process that restores latent life.
Continuous provision gives restored life a sustained supply rather than a single discharge.
A tree putting out blossom turns light into the visible flowering of renewed capacity.
Reaching term and measure supplies maturation of the resumed life.

changed_reading.before: Repentance only cancels a past liability.
changed_reading.after: Repentance may also reactivate provision and growth that had gone dormant, with light as its flowering and completion as maturation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the packet's non-dominant س ع ي mapping and a flight-instability branch of light, so it is deliberately form-distant; it remains anchored by the explicit moving light and immediate request for completion. Render it as a live counter-pressure on triumphal certainty, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The light is already moving, but its bearers still ask that it be completed.

activation_trace.role: Unrestrained going on one's way supplies a competing image of motion that may wander rather than arrive.
Flight and lack of settledness make the light's mobility potentially unstable.
Completion supplies the requested stabilization and sufficient reach of that mobile light.

changed_reading.before: Running light signals an entirely secured and completed outcome.
changed_reading.after: Its motion may retain a risk of scattering or insufficient reach, making the plea for completion structurally urgent rather than ceremonial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Joining textile repair to hydraulic opening is cross-domain and therefore surprising; it remains valid because both operations attach to explicit focus roots and solve the same closure-versus-flow problem. Render it as a material model of repair, not as a claim that the words are synonyms.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Sincere repair is followed by entry into gardens whose opened channels keep water flowing.

activation_trace.role: Stitching a tear supplies selective closure where the structure has ruptured.
Passage into an interior supplies movement across the repaired boundary.
Opening and widening until flow is possible supplies selective openness where circulation is needed.
Continuous streaming verifies that the repaired system has not become sealed and lifeless.

changed_reading.before: Repair means closing every breach and stopping movement.
changed_reading.after: Sound repair closes the damaging rupture while preserving the entrances and channels through which life must circulate.

strongest_changes: D_CALIBRATED_DISCLOSURE: covering becomes proportionate disclosure followed by protection from humiliation.
D_FIRE_LIGHT_REVERSAL: the person moves from fuel of destructive luminosity to bearer of guiding luminosity.
D_NONINHERITED_LIGHT: prophetic accompaniment supports but does not transfer repentance, fidelity, entry, or light.
D_GARDEN_AS_COUNTER_DWELLING: garden-entry becomes construction of a new home after extraction from oppressive relations and work.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converted apparently static religious nouns into operations: sincerity stitched, covering calibrated visibility, light moved and registered work, garden became a counter-home, and guarded boundaries remained permeable to life. Split mappings also kept live two unstable but productive readings: dormant growth resuming and mobile light still needing stabilization.
remaining_uncertainties: The covenantal reading of right-side light is anchored but competes with the direct bodily-side reading.
The fire-to-light relation may be a genuine transformation mechanism or only a tightly placed contrast of outcomes.
The regenerative and unstable-light outliers depend on form-distant branches and should remain analogical rather than lexical claims.
